_comment: Accuracy benchmark for /ask. Starter set of 17 questions grounded in the sources currently in Chroma (money_debt + housing_repair). Grow toward 30 as housing/benefits sources are added. expected_sources = substrings that must appear in at least one returned citation (source_name or url), case-insensitive. expect_refusal = the question must be refused (out of scope or no data).
